biomes.name: Thornmere Basin
biomes.landmark: The Split Bell, a cracked signal bell over the village square
biomes.route: Thornmere ↔ Elderwood; Elderwood is the onward gateway
biomes.resources: Common ore, small private gardens, Reedbank fishing pools, salvage from old farm walls
biomes.threat: Briar-struck road sentries threaten the northern supply route
biomes.project: Restore the northern watchtower and provision the road crews
biomes.discovery: Identify a safe reed-bank crossing and the first waystone inscription
biomes.arc: First Supplies → A Sound from the North → Watchtower at Dusk
biomes.loop: Learn the creator/vocation/mentor flow, choose an outing, prepare a useful product and make the first durable contribution.

biomes.name: Elderwood Frontier
biomes.landmark: The Rootbound Causeway above the Bellroot Vault
biomes.route: Elderwood ↔ Thornmere; Elderwood ↔ Siltfen; Elderwood ↔ Cairnstep
biomes.resources: Veins and ruin salvage, mature timber stands, medicinal specimens and shaded fish habitats
biomes.threat: A rooted warband holds the causeway and disturbs the forest patrols
biomes.project: Repair North Road and open the bridge/merchant route
biomes.discovery: Willow Cut, personal clue sequence and shared shortcut
biomes.arc: Tracks beneath the Canopy → The Missing Fittings → The Bellroot Vault
biomes.loop: The five vocation routes meet at the same bridge without requiring five different human specialists online.

biomes.name: Siltfen Reach
biomes.landmark: The Lantern Sluice, an abandoned flood-control channel
biomes.route: Siltfen ↔ Elderwood; Siltfen ↔ Galehaven through the coastal ferry
biomes.resources: Reed fish, wetland reagents, garden soil samples and recoverable sluice machinery
biomes.threat: Fogbound creatures interrupt the causeway; authored water zones limit safe approaches
biomes.project: Restore the elevated footway and flood-warning station
biomes.discovery: A chain of dry hummocks supplies a non-swimming essential route
biomes.arc: Lanterns in the Fen → A Garden above Water → The Sluice Keeper
biomes.loop: Fish, investigate fictional plant conditions, prepare expedition food/remedy and recover useful components.

biomes.name: Cairnstep Heights
biomes.landmark: The Seven Steps, old watch platforms along a ridge road
biomes.resources: Highland ore, windfallen timber, hardy crops and cold pools
biomes.threat: Patrol camps sever the ridge supply line; wind is an authored modifier, not uncontrolled physics
biomes.project: Reinforce the ridge watch and reopen a safe caravan rest point
biomes.discovery: A sheltered shelf trail offers an alternate expedition route
biomes.arc: The Broken Signal → Timber for the Ridge → Stonehollow Stands
biomes.loop: Choose a safe haul or risky ore expedition, forge/craft supports and protect or provision the road.

biomes.name: Hollowpeak Depths
biomes.landmark: The Quiet Foundry, a buried hall with incomplete warning inscriptions
biomes.route: Hollowpeak ↔ Cairnstep; Hollowpeak ↔ Galehaven via an authored tunnel/harbor gate
biomes.resources: Deep ore and salvage, cave fungi, cistern fish and recoverable old plans
biomes.threat: A patterned guardian encounter blocks a machinery chamber; no precision-platformer traversal
biomes.project: Restore safe ventilation/wayfinding and an expedition supply station
biomes.discovery: Read foundry markings to expose an alternate safe exit
biomes.arc: A Map of Echoes → The Unfinished Alloy → Open Air
biomes.loop: Explore, resolve an encounter variant, select material/formula tradeoffs and bring plans back to surface services.

biomes.name: Galehaven Coast
biomes.landmark: The Stormglass Beacon overlooking the old sea road
biomes.route: Galehaven ↔ Siltfen ferry; Galehaven ↔ Hollowpeak harbor gate
biomes.resources: Coastal fish, drift timber, salt-tolerant crops, fictional storm reagents and wreck salvage
biomes.threat: Storm-season patrol disruption and a clue-driven coastal leader event
biomes.project: Repair the beacon and reopen predictable ferry service
biomes.discovery: Chart a sheltered inlet and the final atlas route
biomes.arc: The Unlit Beacon → A Harbor Supplied → Paths Made Whole
biomes.loop: Combine all vocation production/discovery choices in the final regional arc; the solo route uses NPC aid and alternate objectives.

freeze: At project activation; no retuning of an active goal

faction_extension.public_policy: separate reversible bounded round; never construction or personal-history reset
